mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows actors to modify tasks in teams they are not members of, directly violating the cross-team isolation invariant (FR-014). The assertion checks that every audit entry's actor is a member of the task's team.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamViolation { some ae: AuditEntry, t2: Team | ae.task.team = t2 and no tm: TeamMembership | tm.user = ae.actor and tm.team = t2 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows non-owner members to edit or delete tasks they do not own, and allows non-admin members to modify tasks at all. This directly violates FR-008/009/010.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some ae: AuditEntry, tm: TeamMembership | (ae.change_type = AuditChanged or ae.change_type = AuditDeleted) and tm.user = ae.actor and tm.team = ae.task.team and ae.actor != ae.task.owner and tm.role = Member }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows tasks to exist without a 'created' audit entry, violating FR-015 which requires every task to have an audit trail starting with creation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t and ae.change_type = AuditCreated }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries to record an actor's role that differs from their actual role in that team at the time of the change, violating FR-015's requirement for role snapshots.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleMismatch { some ae: AuditEntry, tm: TeamMembership | ae.actor = tm.user and ae.task.team = tm.team and ae.actor_role != tm.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact removes the definition of which roles can perform which operations, allowing the model to explore inconsistent permission states and violating the feature's permission matrix contract.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermViolation { some ae: AuditEntry, tm: TeamMembership | ae.actor = tm.user and ae.task.team = tm.team and tm.role = Member and (ae.change_type = AuditChanged or ae.change_type = AuditDeleted) and ae.actor != ae.task.owner }
